0x10188CA0.name: ZoneMap_FillDirLight
0x10188CA0.evidence: clears the light fields at param_1 and, when the zone's kind at this-0x1C is not 1, fills a fixed light with the 0x437F0000 values; otherwise, for param_2 0 or 1, copies the direction from DAT_1065CA34 and the colour from this+0x14C or this+0x17C with Vec4_Copy and scales the vector by FUN_10186FD0 or FUN_10186F60; sets the light type to 3; called by XiZone_DrawElement and XiZone::GetDirLight
0x10188CA0.summary: Fills a directional light record from one of the zone's two light sets.
